# discord_webhook (Resource)

Manages a Discord webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_local_image" "avatar" {
  file = "${path.module}/assets/avatar.png"
}

resource "discord_webhook" "example" {
  channel_id      = var.channel_id
  name            = "Notifications"
  avatar_data_uri = data.discord_local_image.avatar.data_uri
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) The channel ID to create the webhook in.
- `name` (String) The name of the webhook (1-80 characters).

### Optional

- `avatar_data_uri` (String) Webhook avatar data URI, for example discord_local_image.data_uri.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the webhook.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The webhook token.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The full webhook URL including the token.
